bonuses.name: Animal
bonuses.text: A Squig is unable to take any actions which would require the use of hands.

bonuses.name: Bouncing Gait
bonuses.text: A Squig adds +1d3 to its Speed each time it runs, charges, or sprints.

bonuses.name: Squig Hound
bonuses.text: GRETCHIN within 3m of a Squig Hound add +2 to their Resolve.

bonuses.name: Squigz Gone Wild
bonuses.text: A Squig which starts its turn without an Ork within 3m, or a RUNTHERD within 6m, becomes Frenzied.

abilities.text: A Bomb Squig which gets within 1m of an enemy will instead Detonate, as described under ANNIHILATION, below. It then dies.

abilities.name: Detonate
abilities.text:
The Bomb Squig explodes.
Bomb Squig Explosion: 16 +3ED / AP -3 / Brutal, Blast (2d3)

mobAbilities.name: Bouncing Charge
mobAbilities.text: A Mob of Attack Squigs add Inflict (Knockdown) to their melee attacks when they charge.
